mapper.select: SELECT connection_id, revision FROM ( SELECT r.dubbo_connection_id AS connection_id, r.dubbo_connection_revision AS revision FROM publication_release r JOIN publication_state s ON (s.live_release_id = r.id OR s.pending_release_id = r.id) JOIN dubbo_connection c ON c.id = r.dubbo_connection_id WHERE r.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND s.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND c.environment_id = #{environmentId} AND c.enabled = true UNION SELECT d.dubbo_connection_id AS connection_id, d.dubbo_connection_revision AS revision FROM catalog_api_draft d JOIN dubbo_connection c ON c.id = d.dubbo_connection_id WHERE d.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND c.environment_id = #{environmentId} AND c.enabled = true ) referenced ORDER BY connection_id, revision LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_api_draft WHERE environment_id=#{environmentId} AND dubbo_connection_id = #{connectionId} AND dubbo_connection_revision = #{revision}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM publication_release r JOIN publication_state s ON (s.live_release_id = r.id OR s.pending_release_id = r.id) WHERE r.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND s.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND r.dubbo_connection_id = #{connectionId} AND r.dubbo_connection_revision = #{revision})
